justification: The main shared content is only generic: both surfaces include profile animals, including quadrupeds, rendered with incised or relief outline and some internal linear detailing. The biggest difference is that A shows a coherent procession of human figures associated with two large horned rams, while B shows a scattered/register-like set of schematic animal and sign motifs with no comparable mounted or led ram scene.
